verdict.rationale: Bundled email forwarding and free SSL are a fair question for a domain registrar, but the evidence pack never mentions either. The bundled extras it does document (free DNSSEC, free WHOIS redaction, mandatory Cloudflare nameservers that are 'automatically protecting' content) are adjacent features, not email forwarding or SSL certificates, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the basics are bundled — email forwarding on my domain and free SSL so the parked-to-launched path costs nothing extra
